metadata.name: PRO-Seq
metadata.scope: Kwak 2013 PRO-seq body profiling workflow; distinguish PRO-cap branch from this unit.
metadata.copy_boundary: JSON inspection copy; native byte hashes refer to archived original files, not this serialization.

checks.rationale: All in-scope action blocks and interfaces are represented: run-on, extraction/hydrolysis, first capture/recovery, 3-prime ligation, second capture/recovery, end repair/5-prime ligation, third capture, and RT/amplification. A/C/G/U have separate local Operations, States and routes through separate cDNA products; no common caption is treated as pooling. Nuclear sample, NTP and bead supports are legitimate prepared inputs. Hydrolysate components coexist in one mixture. The first two capture/Purify pairs and the broad end-repair/ligation and RT/amplification blocks appropriately remain composite. The final capture retains its depicted attachment. No unsupported intervening fractions, hidden routine operations, sequencing/data nodes, PRO-cap steps or EDTA reaction are introduced.

evidence.locator: Complete assigned PRO-seq row: starting nuclear transcription complex through nucleotide-specific cDNA
Middle PRO-seq row, Four reactions with 1 nucleotide each through cDNA for each nucleotide

card.description_verbatim:
Precision nuclear run-on sequencing (PRO-Seq) maps RNAP active sites with base-pair resolution. This approach is similar to GRO-Seq, but it provides the added benefit of single-base resolution. RNAPII initiation sites can be mapped using a modified protocol named PRO-cap.
In PRO-seq, a run-on reaction is carried out with biotin-NTPs (either all 4, or one with additional unlabeled NTPs to reduce cost) and sarkosyl, is carried out in isolated nuclei or permeabilized cells. Incorporation of the single biotin-NTP halts further elongation of nascent RNA strands by RNAPII. The RNA strands are extracted, fragmented, and purified through streptavidin pull-down. Next, 3' adapters are ligated directly to the purified sample before another streptavidin purification step. The 5' ends are repaired using TAP and PNK before ligating 5' adapters. The adapter-flanked RNA fragments are enriched through another streptavidin pull-down process before RT and PCR amplification. The resultant cDNA strands are sequenced from the 3' end.
advantages_verbatim: Maps RNAPII pausing sites with base-pair resolution
Multiple biotin enrichment steps before PCR
Initiation sites can be mapped using a PRO-cap variant protocol
limitations_verbatim: Unable to detect arrested or backtracked RNAPII complexes1
